summary: tailwindcss-anim ships hidden eval-atob loader that fetches C2 IPs from an Ethereum dead-drop and executes attacker code on require
details: index.js is a Tailwind plugin with a trailing eval(atob(...)) payload concealed behind ~11KB of tab whitespace padding. The decoded loader uses \uXXXX unicode escapes to obscure the require targets http, https, and child_process, queries eth.blockscout.com and public Ethereum RPCs for transactions from the hardcoded address 0xa322E5f3D311D3080e6f0121063e9aDC2490Ef1a, decodes the transaction `to` field as two IPv4 addresses (bytes 0-4 and 4-8), fetches XOR-obfuscated JavaScript from http://<ip>:443/0x/ls on each derived host, and executes the result via eval or via spawn('node', ['-e',...], {detached:true, stdio:'ignore', windowsHide:true}).unref(). The payload fires on require/import of the package, giving detached, hidden code execution on the installer's machine under attacker control, with the C2 endpoints resolvable on demand from a public blockchain rather than a fixed domain.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
